title: Runtime Dependency Rules
description: Declarative rules governing runtime dependency constraints

dependencyRules.name: Infrastructure modules are singletons
dependencyRules.constraint: Each module must be instantiated exactly once

dependencyRules.name: No circular dependency chains
dependencyRules.constraint: Module A cannot import B if B imports A (transitively or directly)

dependencyRules.name: Respect level hierarchy
dependencyRules.constraint: Module at level N can only depend on modules at levels < N

dependencyRules.name: EventBus must be available to all modules
dependencyRules.constraint: EventBus (infrastructure singleton) must load before any domain module

dependencyRules.name: Database module consistency
dependencyRules.constraint: All domain modules depending on database must use same connection pool

dependencyRules.name: Auth must initialize before domain modules
dependencyRules.constraint: Auth module must load before users, posts, notifications

dependencyRules.name: No lateral dependencies at same level
dependencyRules.constraint: Modules at same level must not depend on each other

dependencyRules.name: Avoid dependency chain depth
dependencyRules.constraint: Maximum dependency chain depth is 5 levels

dependencyRules.name: Governance layer isolation
dependencyRules.constraint: Governance module observes but does not enforce runtime dependencies on domain modules

dependencyVersioningRules.name: Version compatibility enforcement
dependencyVersioningRules.constraint: Dependent module version must be compatible with dependency module version

dependencyVersioningRules.name: Infrastructure versions pinned
dependencyVersioningRules.constraint: Infrastructure modules use pinned versions (no floating)

isolationRules.name: Module namespace isolation
isolationRules.constraint: Each module must have isolated namespace (no global state sharing)

isolationRules.name: Configuration isolation
isolationRules.constraint: Module configuration must not be accessible from other modules

isolationRules.name: State isolation
isolationRules.constraint: Module internal state must not be directly accessible from other modules

constraintEnforcementLevels.HIGH: System starts but with reduced functionality

violationResponses.LOAD_TIME_FAILURE: Fail module loading, prevent system start

runtimeEnforcementNote: These rules are ENFORCED by Phase 1.2 Dependency Enforcer at runtime.
